title: Terminal-shaped observation is the common upstream seam
summary: Virtual Browser deliberately presents a terminal-compatible, read-only observation protocol so the same upstream monitor/AI automation can inspect terminals and semantic web applications.
invariants: Observation compatibility is protocol/duck-typed, not shared execution inheritance.
Virtual Browser identifies itself through terminalType VIRTUAL-BROWSER while projecting DOM/application state semantically.
Observation snapshots are detached evidence with generation/history semantics.
Sensitive non-display values such as passwords must never enter observable snapshot history.
Observation does not imply or carry browser/terminal mutation authority.

provenance.claim: Observation is the neutral read-only protocol/service shared by Terminal Machine and Virtual Browser.
Virtual Browser v0.9 uses Observation v0.5 while preserving browser/API/placement boundaries.
